# Importing files into R and preparing workspace

<<<<<<< HEAD
We start by importing all the necessary data. We actually already ran the analysis adn the data is stored in ext/instdata. This means we can simply run the prepare workspace command. We also did not prepare the annotations.

```{r load-data}
prepare_workspace(params) # to set up the environment (load the starting object, metadata
gse <- source_object
load_results(params) # load results if we want to skip computations
```

The macrophage dataset requires BP ontology, we delete all the genes from the dataset that are not mapped in it.

```{r check-go}
rownames(gse) <- gsub("\\..*$", "", rownames(gse)) # To remove gene version

ontology_df <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = rownames(gse),
  columns = c("GO", "SYMBOL"),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL"
)

# remove rows with NA GO terms
ontology_df <- ontology_df[!is.na(ontology_df$GO), ]
ontology_df <- ontology_df[!is.na(ontology_df$SYMBOL), ]
ontology_df <- ontology_df[ontology_df$ONTOLOGY == "BP", ]

# remove duplicates for SYMBOL-GO pairs
ontology_df <- ontology_df[!duplicated(ontology_df[c("SYMBOL", "GO")]), ]

gse <- gse[rownames(gse) %in% ontology_df$ENSEMBL, ]
```
